functional_goals_and_modes: A regulated nominal 5V bench source uses the BT2 physical interface and switch S1; ESP32 module regulated 3.3V powers RC522/TFT including its backlight. Shared return is required. The physical three-cell holder does not certify a cell chemistry or lifetime.

Shared SPI: ESP32 GPIO18 SCK,23 MOSI,19 MISO. RC522 select14/reset27; TFT select5/DC21/reset22. With only one select LOW, nominal mode0 100kHz transfers reach the selected module; unselected MISO is HiZ. Use a declared byte-echo surrogate for electrical checks, not real RF or display protocol approval.

Character LCD uses RS32,E33,D4=26,D5=25,D6=4,D7=2, RW ground and 5V supply. Select a 3.3V-compatible TTL input LCD. E falling captures a nibble; successive high/low nibbles form one byte. Potentiometer sets VO across its 0..5V range.

GPIO15 toggles a high-impedance nominal buzzer-equivalent input. Retain physical buzzer interface but choose compatible buffering for an actual buzzer. Check switch off/on, module resets, separate selects, LCD nibble capture and contrast extremes. No server/attendance/network or acoustic qualification.
declared_nominal_loads: 5V source>=200mA; 3.3V rail>=100mA; module nominal quiescent<=10mA each, MCU<=50mA; LCD<=10mA; buzzer-equivalent>=10kohm.
bench_conventions: Common return; no independent peripheral power unless a separated mode explicitly selects it. Power-off signal drivers HiZ; fixtures initialize with rails off and wait for supplies/declared component models to settle before observing states. Unused external contacts individually1Mohm to return in bench fixtures; no floating voltage is inferred. A source NC observation cannot override an explicitly selected public role.
logical_model_boundary: Declared virtual LCD/MCU/card/DRAM/module behavior is a curator-selected nominal test model. It is not installed firmware, a manufacturer guarantee, or evidence of actual source-CAD function. Detailed task fixtures and affected numerical thresholds are fixed in a later immutable task supplement before validation/admission.
R1: Schematic-only public electrical/function scope. Later reference must have actual KiCad10.0.6 all-severity zero error/zero warning, ignored[], no reduced rules/new waivers, and scoped functional positive. No implicit PCB, manufacturing, physical fit or complete external system protocol.
implementation_freedom: Correct observed source errors as needed in a later candidate. Functionally equivalent internal circuitry/layout is allowed; internal net names, copper, UUIDs and component poses are not a scoring gold.
